title: Event log line
description: schema_version 2 (from F1b): every new line has global_id and install_id; bin/event_log.py stamps both on every line it writes. schema_version 1: a line from before the ids; it is never rewritten, it is read and validated as it is, and it is still found by what identified it then (its position in the log and its fields). The schema subset has no conditional, so the schema accepts either version with the ids optional; that a version 2 line has both is the writer's rule.

global_id.description: This line's UUID (lower case, version 4), unique: the writer refuses a line whose global_id is already in the log.

install_id.description: The UUID of the install that wrote the line.
